compiler_cost.protocol: Both compilers compile the same candidate snapshot; outputs must be identical across compilers. Snapshots move through the SAME literal root, compiler, cache and output paths, avoiding path-length and path-content bias. Isolated caches per lane and round; cold then warm in fresh Node processes; AB/BA/AB order; RC=0; compiler/test runs isolated.

limits: LSP latency is advisory and does not imply semantic retention or dependency-aware navigation.
Compiler heap_ptr is static base plus cumulative bump allocation, not live heap, reserved pages or native RSS.
No performance promotion or default cache/entry change.
